works.body:
Hello, thank you very much for taking the time to view my message.

I would like to kindly request an illustration of my character. She has a cool, soft, and mature demeanor. Please feel free to interpret and express this as you see best, as I greatly respect your artistic sense.

Thank you very much for your time and consideration.

https://www.figma.com/board/w2OaR9Vi9ES0gUyIlEABiq/Reference-Sheet-for--yamagamiamami?node-id=0-1&t=h7THRmElAJV1teAV-1

https://www.figma.com/board/w2OaR9Vi9ES0gUyIlEABiq/Reference-Sheet-for--yamagamiamami?node-id=0-1&t=h7THRmElAJV1teAV-1

Dear Amami, nice to meet you.
My name is Rira Mizusei, and I am an individual VTuber.

I saw your beautiful, delicate, and transparent illustrations on X (formerly Twitter), and I would like to request a drawing of my own.

Here are the details of your request.

Intended use
Use in general Vtuber activities including YouTube, thumbnails, Twitter, etc.
Use in icons, channel art, headers, etc.
Limited distribution as wallpaper in FANBOX, online printing, etc.
etc. We would appreciate it if you could let us know in the data if there is anything that cannot be used.

Reference materials
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1JyPIJjhKaBbLk2oG2l5UbI6GBE3e7rsT
The star pattern highlights in the eyes and the inner color of the hair is a gradation with glitter and lame. Also, the pattern of the skirt is the Kotomiza mark, ✨.

Composition, size, etc.
We would like to have a drawing of her with white hair (normal), and would appreciate it if you could draw her with either of the following impressions.
I would appreciate it if you could draw her with either of the following impressions: ・https://x.com/yamagamiamami/status/1891793643586937063?s=46&t=pxwXoLagU5ITXc8xZgPvoQ
→Bright, energetic and cute
https://x.com/yamagamiamami/status/1772995425425142163?s=46&t=pxwXoLagU5ITXc8xZgPvoQ
→Pale and fragile impression

We feel the delicacy and transparency of Amami's world view is very wonderful, so we would be happy if you could leave the specific composition, pose, facial expressions, etc. to us and draw them as you think of them!

Other requests
Please make sure that the person and his/her hair are not visible so that they can be used as thumbnails, etc.
Also, if possible, we would appreciate it if you could provide us with PSD data with separate transparencies for signatures, backgrounds, and figures only.

We understand that you are very busy, but we would appreciate your consideration when you have time.

Dear Amami
I am Toron, and I always enjoy looking at your wonderful illustrations on X (old Twitter) 🌼.
I love Amami's illustrations so much that I requested ☺️ I hope you can draw my guess 🥀.

(I would be happy if you could draw my guesses 🥀.)
◆Fan art of Rui Takamine from "Hollow Live
I would like to have a drawing of Louie Takamine from "HoloLive".
Any costume (original one is fine)
Free background (single color or none)
Layers are not specified.
Size: 1000 x 1500 pixel or more (portrait preferred)
The size should be 1000×1500pixel or more (portrait size is preferred).
Please choose a method that is easy for Amami to do.

(Important point).
I would like to use it for my personal cell phone wallpaper and SNS icons.
I will never use the illustrations in any way that you would find offensive or misuse them.

(Talking about secondary creation)
I have researched about the secondary creation of Hololive, and I believe that it is not against the guideline as it is a skeb request for the purpose of personal adoration.
If you are concerned, don't hesitate to cancel.

I have no experience with skeb requests, so I apologize if my request is poorly worded.
If this is not convenient for you, please cancel the request.
Thank you for your consideration ✨
